{{Quote|Does she ever stop?''"<br />"''I haven't been able to find the off switch.|[[Roan Shryne]] and [[Bol Chatak]] on [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]]|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />}}
'''Olee Starstone''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who was trained first by the [[Jedi librarian/Legends|Jedi librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] and later by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bol Chatak]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She bore a blue [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and was physically fit, but her best skills were those of a researcher and historian, like her original Master.

==Biography==
===Librarian===
{{Quote|Don't try to argue with her. She spent half her life in the Temple library polishing the busts of those Lost Twenty.|[[Roan Shryne]] to [[Jula Shryne|his mother]] on Olee Starstone|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />}}
Olee Starstone was accepted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and grew up in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], where she was selected as a Padawan of the [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]], [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]]. Starstone hoped to one day succeed Nu in her position amongst the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]. Shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in an attempt to broaden her horizons, Starstone went on a mission to [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. It was there that she first met [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Bol Chatak]].<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|This is not the apprenticeship I expected."''<br>''"When we get back to Coruscant, I'll be sure to slip a note into the Temple's suggestion box that Olee Starstone has expressed disappointment with the way she's being trained.|Starstone and Shrine, during the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|Battle of Murkhana]]|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], at the behest of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], Starstone was reassigned to Chatak, becoming her Padawan. The Council felt that athletic, skilled young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were needed more on the battlefield of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] than at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

Two years later, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Starstone and Chatak were among six Jedi who traveled to [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], site of one of the many [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. They were joined by Jedi Master [[Roan Shryne]], who, having lost his former [[Saras Loorne|Master]] and two Padawans during the war, had become disillusioned and bitter, while also losing much of his connection with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Republic High Command/Legends|Republic High Command]] had decided that the policy of "winning the hearts and minds of the Separatists" was the most sound plan for taking Murkhana, having given the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] several weeks to surrender for before launching their attack. During this time, however, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] used the opportunity to seed the atmosphere of the planet with [[anti-laser aerosol]]s, which were designed to scatter [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

Eventually, the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|Battle of Murkhana]] began, the conflict lasting over three weeks. Starstone and Chatak accompanied Shryne and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Salvo (clone trooper)|Salvo]] aboard a wing of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], departing from the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Gallant (Victory I-class)|''Gallant'']]. They assaulted a Corporate Alliance landing platform in [[Murkhana City/Legends|Murkhana City]], and once landed, began to fight across the city. Starstone, Chatak, and Shryne accompanied [[Ion Team]], a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] unit led by Captain [[Climber (clone)|Climber]], to the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] that protected the landing platform. During the fight to destroy the generator, Shryne saved Climber's life by lending him his lightsaber to kill an attacking [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. The group was successful, causing the landing platform to lose its defenses.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

===Order 66===
{{Quote|It's not possible that every Jedi has been killed. Some Jedi weren't even with clone troopers, Master. Other commanders may have refused to obey High Command's execution orders."''<br>''"You're right."''<br>''"We'll find other survivors."''<br>''"You're right."''<br>''"The order will rebuild itself."''<br/>''"Absolutely.|Starstone and Shrine|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />}}
Without warning, Palpatine initiated [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The other three Jedi on Murkhana were quickly ambushed and killed by Salvo and his troops, but Climber and Ion Team refused to carry out the order. Unconvinced that the Jedi had betrayed the Republic, they planned to assist in the escape of their Jedi [[Jedi General/Legends|Generals]]. When Salvo and his men created an ambush for the remaining Jedi, Climber decided to engage his fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], creating a counter-ambush. While the commandos refused to kill their brothers, the confusion they caused was substantial, and Starstone and the others were able to flee the city.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

The Jedi then disguised themselves as mercenaries, hoping to escape the planet along with the rest of the fleeing Separatist forces. With all the droid armies of the Separatists shut down, the clones across the planet turned their attentions to rounding up the mercenaries instead. The Jedi allowed themselves to be captured, hoping to make their escape at a later time, and were brought to a transport that was departing for a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Agon Nine]]. At the same time, however, the mysterious commander known only as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lord Vader]] himself [[Mission to Murkhana (Great Jedi Purge)|arrived]] on the world, seeking the clones that he had heard helped Jedi escape. Starstone and the others witnessed Vader confront the commandos, accusing them of [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. Climber took responsibility for the actions of his team, and told Vader that his actions were justified, as well as calling the man a "lapdog of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]". Vader was furious and ignited his lightsaber, and Ion Team drew their weapons to defend themselves. They fired on the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]], and Vader deftly deflected the bolts back at them, killing two of the clones. Climber and his teammate [[Trace (clone)|Trace]] escaped to a nearby treeline, disappearing into the forest.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

Master Chatak saw an opportunity to dispose of a threat to the galaxy and a killer of Jedi and ignited her hidden lightsaber to reveal her identity to Vader. She attacked him, and the two former allies [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]], with Chatak able to wound one of Vader's [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arms. Ultimately, however, Vader was too powerful for her, and he [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] Chatak. Upon Chatak's death, Vader scanned the crowd of prisoners, his gaze landing on Starstone, but he was distracted before being able to confront her. Shryne subsequently managed to use a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] that allowed himself and Starstone to escape from the prison transport, and once more attempt to flee the city. It was not long, however, until [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]] discovered that two prisoners were missing from their initial count, and the clone deduced that these two were in fact the missing Jedi.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

After much grieving and running, Starstone became convinced that Vader had to be a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], but Shryne would not believe her. He contacted an old ally of his, the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Cash Garrulan]]. Garrulan was a former [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] and an [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] for the Jedi Order. He informed them of the devastating [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attack on the Jedi Temple]] and agreed to get them offworld. He set up the ''[[Dead Ringer]]'' as a decoy, complete with two Humans hidden on board, while giving Starstone and Shryne a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] to leave the planet. Starstone and Shryne were finally able to escape Murkhana, with the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following close behind.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

===The dark times===
{{Quote|I trust that all of you understand there can be no contact among us&mdash;ever again. That's going to be the hardest part for me. I guess I've grown attached to all of you. But I'm certain of this much: Palpatine's Empire will rot from the inside out, and eventually someone will cast him from his throne. I only hope that all of us are alive to witness that day.|Starstone, after the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]]|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />}}
Starstone and Shryne eventually rendezvoused with the ''[[Drunk Dancer]]'', which was captained by Shryne's mother, [[Jula Shryne|Jula]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]' ship's young [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], [[Filli Bitters]], immediately began flirting with Starstone, and Shryne, who had already given up on his life as a Jedi, was disappointed that she ignored Bitters due to her strict adherence to the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]].<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

Starstone, rather than Shryne, took the lead in gathering survivors of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], contrary to the intentions of Jedi such as [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. By this point, Shryne had discarded his lightsaber, intent on taking up the life of a smuggler. Jula, however, was more eager to help the young Jedi. She and Starstone searched planets such as [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] and [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] for survivors of the purge but found none. Eventually, Starstone did manage to track down other survivors, gathering Jedi such as [[Siadem Forte]], [[Iwo Kulka]], and Forte's Padawan, [[Deran Nalual]], as well as two young Jedi from the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]]: [[Jambe Lu]] and [[Nam Poorf]]. The Jedi soon resolved to travel to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], hoping to find a sign of Jedi Masters such as Yoda, [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] or [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]].<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

Unknown to the Jedi, Palpatine and Vader were aware of their plans, and devised a trap in order to accomplish several goals. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] would use the presence of Jedi on the planet to invade and [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], who were resisting the transition of the Republic into an Empire. The invasion began almost as soon as the Jedi arrived planetside, and Vader and Commander Appo descended into the Wookiee villages in order to engage the Jedi themselves. Starstone and the others, realizing they had been led into a trap, counterattacked alongside the Wookiees, felling many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. While Forte and Kulka battled Appo and his men, Vader dueled Starstone, and, seeing Vader's power, the other Jedi joined in, hoping to overpower him. Vader [[Cho mai/Legends|sliced off]] Lu's right arm, Poorf's right leg, and beheaded Forte and Kulka in one strike, leaving Starstone to face him alone. She held her own against the more powerful duelist but was soon close to defeat. Just then, Shryne joined the fight, [[Telekinesis/Legends|drawing]] Forte's lightsaber to him and killing Appo.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

Shryne challenged Vader to a duel, allowing the younger Jedi to escape. Starstone, along with her Wookiee ally [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], helped Lu and Poorf flee Kashyyyk aboard the ''Drunk Dancer.'' Shryne dueled Vader alone, and through a protracted battle managed to hold off the Sith Lord for a time. Eventually, Vader overwhelmed Shryne by hurling dozens of objects at him all at once, wounding him grievously. While Vader attempted to taunt Shryne for his defeat, Shryne countered that he should thank Vader for making him one with the Force once more.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

Following the death of Shryne, Starstone realized she could no longer openly live as a Jedi, but should follow the examples of Kenobi and Yoda and escape into anonymity for the time being. Allowing herself to make attachments, she joined the crew of the ''Drunk Dancer'', alongside Chewbacca. Starstone vowed to fight the Empire in any subtle way she could.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It's not a criticism. What I mean is that I was the same way at the Jedi Temple library. Someone would come in looking for data, and I would almost always be able to direct them right to the files they needed. I just had a sense for it. I think you should be proud of doing what you do best, instead of hiding behind false humility, or letting disillusion convince you that you need a new life.|Starstone to [[Filli Bitters]]|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />}}
Olee Starstone was very devoted to the Jedi Order and refused to allow the Jedi flame to be extinguished. At first, she didn't believe the Jedi should hide from the Sith, but she later realized that she could no longer live safely as a Jedi and went into hiding. During her duel with Darth Vader, she briefly used her rage as power but then calmed herself down, even as Vader encouraged her to use her anger to connect to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

She was noted by Roan Shryne and her Master Bol Chatak as being inquisitive and quick-tongued, spouting off several theories on the clones' betrayal and Vader's identity in quick succession.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

Starstone was considered an attractive girl by Filli Bitters, but her devotion to the Jedi Code prevented her from returning his feelings. Eventually, however, she did allow herself to form attachments, as shown by hugging and crying with Jula over Shryne's death.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|A librarian with the Force&hellip; Very dangerous combination|[[Brudi Gayn]]|<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />}}
Despite her young age, Starstone was an athletic and skilled Jedi. Though a Padawan, she managed to hold her own against Darth Vader, notably being the last Jedi standing before Roan Shryne arrived to rescue them.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />

In addition to being a skilled duelist, Starstone showed promise as a Jedi researcher, having once been the Padawan of Chief Librarian Jocasta Nu.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" />
